exposure: transvaginal ultrasound in placenta accreta spectrum scoring category
outcome: estimated blood loss during primary surgery
cohort: The study included 78 consecutive patients referred to a quaternary center for suspected placenta accreta spectrum from 2023 to 2024.
finding: The transvaginal ultrasound in placenta accreta spectrum scoring system (specifically Category 3) was confirmed to be associated with higher estimated blood loss and increased surgical complexity in patients with suspected placenta accreta spectrum.
mod_finding: Surgical management, including the rate of cesarean hysterectomy and conservative management, differed significantly across the placenta accreta spectrum scoring categories, with higher categories associated with more extensive interventions.
